scope: FBS functionality selected by the user; main tranches precede bonuses
constraints: Research and verify native FBS capabilities before implementing them
Use atomic commits and rigorous tests during implementation; end-to-end feature benchmarking can follow implementation
Development testing does not submit real bookings, amendments, cancellations or approvals
Do not replace an unsupported native amendment with cancellation/rebooking implicitly

main.feature: Batch review and execution with individual outcomes

evaluation_policy.applies_to: Every selected main feature and bonus; split-room planning is only an example
evaluation_policy.baseline: Codex CLI completing the same natural-language task with the previous tools and agent-written orchestration
evaluation_policy.measurements: Total reported model token usage and end-to-end completion time, with equivalent correctness and coverage
evaluation_policy.timing: Build and test the feature first; comparative benchmarking may come later
evaluation_policy.retention: Rework, consolidate or remove features that do not demonstrate worthwhile token and speed savings
evaluation_policy.evidence: Fewer tool calls, smaller payloads and backend timings alone do not establish end-to-end savings

excluded: Calendar/export features and all other unselected proposals
status: Implementation starting; this file records agreed scope, not completed functionality
